implementation: Removes only tu-debug=noubwc,nocb from the device-tested cadence-b command line. The kernel, ADT, owner trust cache, Data seed, Recovery wrapper, GPU addon and every other option are byte-identical to cadence-b.

With the argument absent the Turnip frontend sets no TU_DEBUG, so allow_concurrent_binning follows A6XX drirc and UBWC stays enabled: this board has run with UBWC bandwidth compression and concurrent binning disabled since the white-screen investigation, and that investigation used pipa-turnip-debug, which neither packaged frontend reads.
The change tests GPU bandwidth and binning overlap as the source of the 7.592 ms mean GPU fence wait measured on cadence-b; it changes no display, fence, latch or retirement code.
verification: The preserved payload members (kernel, ADT, trust cache, Data seed) compare byte-equal before and after the menu edit, and the packed Recovery's payload is compared against the edited payload.
The menu round-trips to 973 bytes with exactly one removed argument and no added argument.
The Recovery is 86888448 bytes; final size, FAT readback and packed-payload readback passed.

device_result.boot: Recovery bbf7d1f5 booted the 21H461 desktop and restored paired USB.
device_result.numbers: Mean interval 34.156 ms against 26.510 ms on cadence-b. Fence wait 5.054 ms against 7.592 ms; post-arrival 4.578 ms against 5.698 ms; arrival 20.677 ms against 11.467 ms; ack 9.129 ms against 9.775 ms. Zero copy fallback, zero CTL timeout.

limits: Host result plus a verified RECOVERY upload. The upload does not establish boot, and the experiment is unmeasured until the same interaction workload is captured on this image. Visual corruption, a return of the settings-page artifacts, or a worse GPU fence wait means UBWC or concurrent binning has to be restored and bisected separately.
